class.name: NNDotProductToPositionVector2SearchCriterion
class.brief_description: Filters and scores [Node2D] candidates by whether a global 2D position is in front of or behind them.
class.description: Takes the dot product between each [Node2D] candidate's facing direction (+X rotated by global rotation) and the direction toward [member dot_product_position], mapping [code]-1..1[/code] to [code]0..1[/code] when scoring. Use to select cover spots or targets facing toward (or away from) a 2D position. To compare against a fixed direction vector instead of a position, use [NNDotProductVector2SearchCriterion].

members.member: Global 2D position checked against each candidate's facing direction.

Comparison rule ([code]LessThan[/code], [code]LessOrEqual[/code], [code]Equal[/code], [code]MoreOrEqual[/code], or [code]MoreThan[/code]) against [member filtering_value]. Candidates matching this comparison are filtered out when filtering is enabled.
Dot product threshold ([code]-1.0..1.0[/code]) used by [member filtering_rule] when filtering is enabled.
